alex: Quick check-in on the continuous-batching probe results I uploaded — short summary below. TL;DR: splitting prompt-length buckets improved p95 by ~12% overall, but we're seeing a p99 regression for mid-length prompts (33-128) when KV miss rate exceeds ~20%. The decode-rate bucket at ~70 tok/s is noisy on high-variance workloads. Thoughts on adjusting token_budget_target, kv prefetch, and kernel hints?

alex: probe config I ran (human-friendly):
```
length_buckets: [0-32, 33-128, 129-512, 513+]
decode_rate_buckets: [0-25, 26-70, 71+]
token_budget_targets: [16, 32, 48, 64]
kv_prefetch_tokens: 8
kernel_hint: auto
metrics: [p50, p95, p99, kv_miss_rate, tokens/sec]
```

jin: Nice, thanks for the summary. For the mid-length p99 regression I suspect kv eviction / prefetch timing. Can we try kv_prefetch_tokens 8->16 for bucket 33-128 and reduce token_budget from 48->40 for bucket 129-512 to avoid overcommit? Also map kernel_hint for 129-512 -> "matmul-fast" to favor lower-latency matmul paths.

marta: Agree on increasing kv_prefetch for the mid bucket. One more thing: the static decode-rate cut at 70 tok/s is brittle — suggest switching to percentile-based dynamic buckets (e.g., 50th/90th decode-rate percentiles sampled hourly) to avoid noisy boundary shifts. We have a small helper: /infra/tools/bucketize.py that outputs boundaries from recent traces.

sam: Heads up — the p99 regression might also be exacerbated by the kernel-fallback change from last week (commit 3f2a9b). I observed extra kernel selection churn on A100s leading to context-switchy behavior. If tuning doesn't help fast, consider canary-reverting the fallback for the affected pool.

alex: Good catch @sam. I'll spin a canary with kv_prefetch=16 for 33-128 and a kernel_hint override to force matmul-fast on 129-512, and run it for ~2h on a small traffic slice. Can everyone add exact success criteria so I can automate the cutoff? I'll also collect perf traces and upload a gist.

jin: Success criteria proposal: p99 <= baseline + 5% AND kv_miss_rate <= 18% for mid bucket AND tokens/sec not decreased by more than 3% overall.

marta: Also add cost constraint: cost_per_1k_tokens doesn't increase by >4%. And GPU kernel utilization (per-kernel) remains within +/-5% of baseline to avoid unexpected stalls.

sam: Add monitoring note: watch logs for the string "stall_detected" and track occurrences. If we see >5 occurrences/minute in the canary, abort and rollback. Also check for increased kernel fallback rate in the kernel-selection metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for experiment 'spline-cohort-splitter-2026-03-18' on pool 'canary-3' initiated by alex.

alex: Thanks all — will post the profiling gist & perf dashboard link in ~2h. Ping me directly if you see any alarming alerts in the meantime.
